text:
alex: noticed elevated host CPU on canary after microcodec packing landed. p95 up ~25ms, GPU looks fine. anyone grabbed host traces? :thinking:
infra-bot: alert: canary-ingress_cpu_high (https://ops.redwood/canary/14)
priya: pulled a quick pprof. tokenization and proto unpacking are the hotspots. flame:
```
pprof flame (host):
 - host::tokenize 45%
 - parse::proto_unpack 30%
 - ingress::frame_router 8%
 - socket::read 3%
```
jon_s: microcodec packs tiny records into frames which changed observed segment shapes. kernel chooser opted into a short-seq kernel (id=7) that is suboptimal for lots of small segments. also KV hitrate dropped which may add CPU for rehydration.
samira: KV metrics show hitrate fell from ~88% to ~71% post-deploy; evictions spiked. microcodec changes alter prefix boundaries so cached keys are less reusable.
priya: plan: experiment with ingress-side coalescing (increase coalesce window from 2ms -> 8ms) to rejoin tiny frames before tokenize. pushing canary-14 with that change.
deploy-bot: deploy planned: priya/ingress-coalesce -> canary-14 (https://ci.redwood/build/2356)
jon_s: parallel experiment: force kernel fallback / override for seq_len<128 to kernel_id=3 for a small host subset (tag: canary-14-kerneltest). should reduce decode tail.
alex: agree on non-revert mitigations first. if coalesce + kernel override recovers metrics we'll keep microcodec changes. otherwise consider per-tenant opt-out.
samira: running KV heatmap capture now. early logs show repeated GET misses for keys with new shortened prefixes and several EVICTs in quick succession.
priya: canary-14 initial telemetry (10 hosts, 10m): host CPU down ~10% vs canary-13, p95 reduced ~12ms, KV hitrate increased to ~82%. improvement but not fully baseline.
jon_s: kernel override test added another ~6ms p95 reduction in small bench. suggests both fixes are complementary.
alex: keep both running and collect 1h of telemetry. if stable, ship ingress coalesce and kernel chooser fallback patches. also plan a follow-up to update kv-keying to be more resilient to frame boundary changes.
priya: opened PR for ingress-coalesce and documented the flag. will attach perf graphs.
infra-bot: alert cleared for canary-14.
alex: thanks team. if perf returns to baseline we'll roll to prod gradually. will write short postmortem if we see recurrence.
